messages:
Marta L.: Heads-up — Calypso private/VPC cutover is scheduled for tonight 23:00 PT. Need a quick sync on who is executing, smoke checks, and rollback readiness. I booked a 30m quiet window.

Devon H.: I'll be primary for the deploy. ETA to start 23:00, expected finish ~23:12 if no surprises. I'll run the infra steps and apply the k8s manifests.

Ali R.: I'll support app-level validation and run smoke tests immediately after rollout. Planning to run the usual sanity suite + the new latency probe.

Marta L.: Perfect. Kevin, can you be on standby for networking / VPN flaps? Last time we saw an SG rule that needed a tweak.

Kevin S.: On it. I'll monitor route tables and BGP/peering. If anything blocks, I'll roll the SG back with the saved config.

Jen P.: FYI I updated the runbook and pushed to the private repo: https://git.internal/redwood/calypso/runbooks/cutover.md. Key changes: clearer KV cache warmup, and an explicit 5-minute post-cut smoke window.

Devon H.: Copy. My preflight checklist (short):
1) confirm dimmer flag off
2) drain canary nodes
3) apply manifests
4) wait for pods ready
5) run warmup scripts

Ali R.: Smoke steps I'll run manually (commands below) — posting here so we have a record:
```
# verify basic generation\curl -s -X POST $CALYPSO_HOST/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"healthcheck"}' | jq .text
# embedding sanity\curl -s $CALYPSO_HOST/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"test"}' | jq .data
# latency probe (10 samples)
for i in {1..10}; do curl -s -w '\\n%{time_total}\\n' -o /dev/null $CALYPSO_HOST/health; done
```

Marta L.: Good. Rollback plan: if app errors >3% or 95th latency > 2x baseline in the 5-minute smoke window, we revert to previous deployment and re-enable dimmer. Agreed?

Kevin S.: Agreed. Network rollback: restore SGs and route table snapshot taken at 22:45 PT. I'll have the snapshot ready.

Devon H.: I will tag the current image and keep it available for quick re-deploy: `calypso:stable-20260317-2200`. If we need rollback I can reapply in ~3 mins.

deploy-bot: Reminder — scheduled maintenance window starts 23:00 PT (2102468400). Please confirm final thumbs-up 15m before.

Marta L.: Thumbs-up. We'll do a 10:45pm stand-by ping. Small note: Ali, can you capture a short log snippet and post if anything looks off so we can roll back faster?

Ali R.: Yep — I'll post snippets and call out error patterns. Will also tag any anomalies with `calypso-cutover` in the logs.

Jen P.: I'll be watching the console dashboards (tokens, errors, latency). If anything trends bad I'll @marta and @devon immediately.

Marta L.: Thanks team — final checklist for tonight:
- [Devon] deploy run at 23:00 PT
- [Kevin] networking standby, snapshots ready
- [Ali] smoke commands + log capture
- [Jen] dashboards + runbook owner
- [Marta] coordinate rollback decision

See you all on the thread at ~22:45 PT for the final go/no-go. :thumbsup:
